instrumentation: Adds counters to properties, unique, uniqueRaw, components, sourceMobs and trackDurations. For unique and uniqueRaw, names are matched once into a local const vector before looping so the exact nonempty-list counts can be recorded; it is the same list and preserves inspection order/results. No extra property-name/class lookup is performed for classification. Original HEAD source is saved beside the instrumentation-only diff.

counts.propertiesCalls: Every call to properties() constructs a temporary QVector, including empty lists. This includes unique/uniqueRaw calls and all other callers.
counts.propertySlotsScanned: Sum of object.properties.size() across every properties() call; loops inspect every property slot.
counts.nonemptyTemporaryPropertyLists: All properties() results with at least one matched pointer, irrespective of caller. This counts nonempty vector instances, not allocator calls; multiple growth allocations per vector are not counted.
counts.uniqueCalls: Calls to unique(); each calls properties() exactly once.
counts.uniqueRawCalls: Calls to uniqueRaw(); each calls properties() exactly once.
counts.uniqueNonempty: unique() calls whose temporary properties() result has at least one pointer.
counts.uniqueRawNonempty: uniqueRaw() calls whose temporary properties() result has at least one pointer.
counts.reported98161: Round 3 uniqueNonempty 96250 + uniqueRawNonempty 1911 = 98161. This is only the nonempty lists created for unique/uniqueRaw, not all properties() calls or all nonempty lists.
counts.sourceMobsRepeatedCalls: sourceMobsCalls minus distinct input object handles; does not assert identical completed results under cancellation.
counts.componentsRepeatedCalls: componentsCalls minus distinct input object handles.
counts.trackDurationRepeatedMasterCalls: trackDurationCalls minus distinct master object handles; file-specific inputs remain separate.
